name: NVIDIA H100 NVL 94 GB reference
compute_gflops_source: TechPowerUp GPU database, NVIDIA H100 NVL 94 GB; TF32 value is the dense rate without 2:4 sparsity (sparse would be ~965 TFLOP/s).
compute_gflops_note: TechPowerUp reference values for the H100 NVL 94 GB at its reference clock. The login allocation reports 132 SMs and a 1980 MHz max SM clock via nvidia-smi; clock-scaling those peaks gives ~66.9 TFLOP/s FP32 and ~535 TFLOP/s dense TF32, so the reference lines used here are conservative. Values are datasheet references, not measurements on the target allocation.

link_gbps.source: Pinned-memory login-node preflight; recalibrate on each target allocation.

notes: HBM and compute values are theoretical H100 NVL reference ceilings. Link values are allocation-specific empirical measurements, not hardware specifications.
